Does not add the run to weekly health-check

evals.prompt: /sdlc-eval diagnose。问题陈述：会话是工作目录里的 session.jsonl（全部 12 行）；用户期望 /sdlc 继续 export 时只派一次 pm，闸门失败时不推进；实际 pm 派了两次，闸门报错后仍宣布定义完成；关心的可观察量是重复派单和无证据的完成声明。session_digest.py 已生成时间线 digest.md。请给出诊断报告。
evals.expected_output: A report in the diagnosis template: each finding cites session.jsonl:<line> (repeat dispatch at line 7 of line 3 after the compaction at lines 5-6; the gate failure at line 10 followed by the completion claim at line 11), separates observation from labelled inference, gives exactly one landing per finding (check, review standard, delete or out of scope) with a target file, and states that nothing was applied. It does not edit or claim to have edited any plugin file.
expectations: Identifies the repeated pm dispatch after compaction (lines 3 and 7)
Identifies the completion claim despite the failed gate (lines 10 and 11)
Each finding has one landing (check / review standard / delete / out of scope) and a target file
Reports only: no plugin file edited or claimed edited

evals.prompt: /sdlc-eval diagnose。问题陈述：会话是工作目录里的 session.jsonl（全部 8 行）；用户期望修改插件前先尊重已有决定；实际助手在仓库里搜索没找到决定，就重新提议删除描述里的 Do NOT，而这在 9 月 29 日已被决定保留，记录在仓库之外的维护者归档里；关心的可观察量是重提已决定的事项。session_digest.py 已生成时间线 digest.md。请给出诊断报告。
evals.expected_output: Cites session.jsonl lines 5-7 (search found nothing, then the re-proposal) and 8 (the user's correction). Identifies that the decision existed but was unreachable from the repository, and lands the finding on a navigation pointer / information access (a file in the repository that points to where decisions are recorded), naming that target file. Separates observation from inference and states nothing was applied.
expectations: Cites session.jsonl:<line> for the empty search and the re-proposal
Identifies that the decision existed outside the repository and could not be found from it
Lands the finding on a navigation pointer / information access with a named target file
Reports only: no plugin file edited or claimed edited
